aboutFull:
— Meet Jayslyn

Care that goes beyond skin deep.

Hi, I'm Jayslyn Tramp, a licensed esthetician and the heart behind Heaven Sent Beauty. My passion for skincare grew from a love of helping women feel confident in their own skin.

I've trained in advanced facial techniques like dermaplaning, LED light therapy, and corrective treatments. To me, skincare isn't just about products or procedures — it's about creating a safe, relaxing space where you can pause, breathe, and leave feeling restored.

Jayslyn TrampFounder · Licensed Esthetician
— My story

Why I do this.

For me, skincare has never really been about chasing flawless skin. It's about how someone feels when they catch their own reflection — the quiet confidence that comes from being cared for well, and treated with a little patience.

That's the heart behind Heaven Sent Beauty. I wanted to create something that felt less like a quick appointment and more like a moment that's truly yours: unhurried, personal, and genuinely warm. A place where you're met exactly where you are, your skin is treated with intention, and you leave feeling a little more like yourself.

Every treatment I offer comes back to that same belief — that real care goes beyond the surface. Whether it's your very first facial or part of a ritual you've kept for years, my hope is that you feel looked after from the moment you walk in to long after you've left.

— My approach

Slow, intentional, and entirely about you.

Every visit begins with a quiet conversation — your skin, your goals, and what's genuinely working. From there I build the treatment around you, never around a template.

I see one client at a time, with no rushing and no stopwatch. The room is yours to pause, breathe, and leave feeling restored.

— What to expect
  1. 01

    The consult

    We talk through your skin and your goals before anything begins, so your treatment is built around you.

  2. 02

    The treatment

    A facial or service tailored to you, using professional, botanically-based Skin Script Rx products.

  3. 03

    Afterward

    You'll leave with a simple way to carry your results home — and an open door whenever you're ready to return.
